skill.displayName: US Stock Valuation Model - Value Investing Framework / 美股估值模型-价值投资框架

version.changelog: Initial release: EN-first bilingual framework with expanded scoring model, risk controls, and evaluator script.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is a local, deterministic value-investing evaluator that consumes a JSON input and produces scorecards/reports with no external network access or secret requirements.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (US value-investing framework) matches the included files: a methodology document, an input JSON template, and a Python evaluator script that implements the described scoring and outputs a verdict. There are no environment variables, unrelated binaries, or requests for cloud credentials that would be inconsistent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent/user to run the bundled Python script with a provided input JSON. The script only reads the specified input file, computes scores deterministically, writes JSON and optional markdown to the provided output paths (creating parent directories as needed), and prints a one-line summary. It does not make network requests, read other system files, or access environment variables. Note: the script writes files into whatever path you pass (the example uses a .state directory); review the output path to ensure you are comfortable with writable locations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and the included code uses only Python standard library modules (argparse, json, pathlib). This is low-risk: nothing is downloaded or executed from external URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no credentials or environment variables. That is appropriate given it is a local evaluator that expects pre-supplied financial metrics in JSON form. No unrelated secrets are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not alter other skills or system-wide settings. Its only persistence is writing output files to the paths you specify; it does not attempt to install itself or store tokens elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a local, deterministic evaluator — it does not fetch market data or require API keys, so you must supply accurate metric inputs yourself. Before running: (1) inspect the provided input JSON to ensure it contains no sensitive data, (2) choose safe output paths (the script will create directories and write JSON/markdown files where you point it), and (3) confirm you have a trusted Python 3 runtime. If you want live prices or automated data collection, expect to add integrations that will require credentials; review any such additions carefully for network endpoints and required secrets. Overall the bundle appears coherent and low-risk.
